title: Q-LLM-copilot-route: no key-less frontier route exists after GitHub Models; add Copilot CLI on GITHUB_TOKEN as the first rung where the org policy allows it
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** GitHub Models retired 2026-07-30
**Done check:** cmd:git grep -q copilot-actions -- doctrine/code-agents.json
**Closing probe:** cmd:git grep -q copilot-actions -- doctrine/code-agents.json
**Prediction:** executor_runs_failed_share_7d <= 0.1 within 168 h
**Out of scope:** buying a model key; changing the Workers AI rungs
**Status:** open

Problem: Copilot CLI in Actions needs `copilot-requests: write` and an org Copilot plan plus the policy 'Allow use of Copilot CLI billed to the organization'. The adapter must be health-checked with a canary reply validated against a schema each run and demoted for the run on failure (route_down in foundation/agent_ladder.py). The org plan is identity-bound: if the canary fails for policy, file one gate with the default (Workers AI rungs) in effect.
